description: Mailchimp connected site script on chimpstatic.com/mcjs-connected/js/users/{user}/{site}.js. Mailchimp's Connected Sites API documents that URL. list-manage.com forms are not contracted.

params.name: user_id
params.description: It is the Mailchimp user hash in the connected-site script URL.
params.fix_hint: Copy the connected-site snippet from Mailchimp Integrations so the path is /js/users/{user}/{site}.js.

params.name: site_id
params.description: It is the connected-site hash. Mailchimp documents site_script.url as /js/users/{user-hash}/{site-hash}.js.
params.fix_hint: Keep both path segments from the generated Mailchimp snippet.
